# `sign_in_attempt`

Area: **users** ([all tables](README.md))

Sign-in attempts of the last minute, one row per throttle key and attempt (20 a minute per user and address and per address). Rows older than a minute are deleted with each attempt.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `text` | no |  | The throttle key: user\|<username, case-folded>\|<address> or address\|<address>. |
| `at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the attempt was made (injected clock). |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `sign_in_attempt_key_check` | check | `CHECK ((key <> ''::text))` |
